optimization_targets.trio_policy: Increase trifecta-box/trio hit capture only through improvements that preserve or improve axis and candidate coverage across large-sample and unseen validation.

shared_selection_core.rule: All wager types share the same horse-selection core: axis durability, candidate pool, partner roles, third-place intrusion and failure scenarios.
shared_selection_core.trio: Primary development surface for 3-horse combination coverage.
shared_selection_core.place: Reads axis 3rd-place durability from the shared core.
shared_selection_core.wide: Reads two-horse simultaneous survival from the shared core.
shared_selection_core.quinella: Adds 1st/2nd-place reach requirements to the shared core.
shared_selection_core.win: Adds win-out requirements to the shared axis core.
shared_selection_core.trifecta: Adds finishing-order reproducibility to the shared three-horse core.
shared_selection_core.coupling_policy: Do not create an isolated trio-only horse ranking. Improvements to horse selection, candidate coverage or intrusion detection must feed every derived wager analysis before wager-specific conditions are applied.
